name: Sarah M.
text: This was so helpful! My daughter hated being swaddled at first, but once I figured out the right technique from your article, she slept so much better. We stopped around 3 months when she started rolling.

name: James T.
text: Question: does swaddling affect their ability to self-soothe later? I've read conflicting things online and want to make sure I'm not creating dependency.

name: Michelle D.
text: Honestly, my son was a swaddle escape artist from day one. Not every baby cooperates, so don't stress if it doesn't work for yours. There are other ways to help them feel secure.
